  - Investigated platform issues across chat, audio/video, and project management, authoring 10+ Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documents.
  - Implemented the Secrets & Keys management feature using React and backend REST APIs for secure credential storage.
- **OmniqAI Pvt Ltd** — AI R&D Intern (May 2025 – Jun 2025 | Bengaluru, India)
  - Developed an MCP (Model Context Protocol) agent orchestration proof-of-concept integrated with Mailcow for DevOps and AI workflows using FastAPI, Docker, Playwright, and SonarQube.
- **OmniqAI Pvt Ltd** — AI Research Intern (Dec 2024 – Jan 2025 | Bengaluru, India)
  - Built a Knowledge Graph microservice (Neo4j, Python, Ollama) grounded on Slack conversational data for RAG pipelines.
  - Containerized with Docker Swarm and Gitea CI; monitored with Prometheus.
